notes: Slabs, standard deductions, rebate limits and cess were checked against the secondary sources listed above on 2026-11-16 and match across them. They were NOT checked against the CBDT tax reference tables directly, so verified stays false. Surcharge brackets are the commonly published brackets and were not independently verified in this pass. Every UI using this pack must show a verify on the official portal note. The calculator covers resident individuals under 60 only. Senior citizen slabs, special-rate income (capital gains), and marginal relief above the surcharge thresholds are not modelled. New regime marginal relief just above the rebate limit IS modelled: pre-cess tax is capped at the amount by which taxable income exceeds the rebate limit. Home loan interest cap (Rs 200,000) is carried from the previous app values and was not independently verified in this pass.
